title: Virtual host configuration
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of an $m$-work-tape machine on input $y$, with Boolean symbols and states in $S$. Given a Boolean tag $b$, a new input-head position $p$ for input $x$, and a Boolean list $\mathrm{pre}$, form a configuration with $m+1$ work tapes and states in $S\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$: its state is $c$’s state paired with $b$, its input-head position is $p$, its first work tape is the buffer tape initialized from $y$, and its remaining work tapes and head positions are those of $c$. The head position on the first tape is $c$’s input-head index minus one, and the output is $\mathrm{pre}$ followed by $c$’s output.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration on input $y$ with $m$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states in $S$
$p$ is a valid input-head position for $x$
